verdict.rationale: Bevy is a code-first engine: a project is a normal Rust/cargo project driven without an editor, so most project content is plain source code that works naturally with version control. It also ships a Scene system for creating, saving, loading and hot-reloading ECS worlds, and community notes mention .meta asset files. However, nothing in the evidence says scene or meta files are text-based, diffable or mergeable, and nothing addresses multi-person workflows. Missing for 10: documented diffable/text scene format, merge-friendly scene or asset files, built-in collaboration or team workflow tooling, independent reports of team/VCS usage.
